description: List the category index for the buyable catalog. Prerequisite: none — pure local read, no VM or lot required. Returns one entry per category in the roommate-buyer whitelist (categories 12..20), with a human-readable name and the count of items currently available. Categories with zero qualifying items are omitted. Cost: none (no budget or lot state changed). Effect: provides the orientation map you need before calling search-catalog with a category filter — it tells you what kinds of things exist and how many of each, so you can decide where to shop without scanning the full item list.
call_signatures: cf $CF list-catalog-categories                                                       # no args; returns [{category_id, category_name, count}] for whitelisted categories with ≥1 item
common_mistakes: Only categories 12..20 (the RoomieWhiteList) are returned — lower-numbered categories (appliances, etc.) require owner/builder permissions and are not returned here.
count reflects items where DisableLevel==0 and GUID not blacklisted — the same filter chain as find-cheap-catalog-guid and buy-object.
A category absent from the response means zero qualifying items exist, not that the category is undefined.
perception_hints: Use the returned category_id values as the category filter argument when calling search-catalog.
count gives you a rough idea of selection depth before committing to a search.
